name: ScenarioPlanner
description: What-if sliders per driver with live totals, deltas and saved assumptions.
lede: Nudge each driver up or down and watch the total, delta and every driver update instantly.

roles.name: driver
roles.help: The items you want to flex (for example product or cost line).

roles.name: base
roles.help: The baseline value for each driver.

roles.name: target
roles.help: Optional target total to compare the scenario against.

steps: Add a Driver and its Base value.
Move a slider to change a driver by a percentage.
Watch Scenario total and Delta update.
Reset to start again; your assumptions are saved with the report.

faq.a: No. Scenarios are calculated in the visual and never change your model.
